request.prompt: Smooth, confident noir jazz-funk for robbing a grand old bank with marble floors and brass fittings. 90 BPM, G minor, 4/4, steady tempo throughout. Brushed drums with a laid-back swing, a deep upright bass groove, a baritone saxophone playing low sly phrases, a muted trumpet answering it with a five-note minor blues motif, warm Hammond organ chords underneath, and soft vibraphone accents. Cool and patient, a little smug. Structure: 8-bar A, 8-bar variation of A, 8-bar B where the trumpet takes over, a 4-bar quiet breakdown with just bass and brushes, then 8 bars of A again. No intro, no ending, no fade: it must loop seamlessly. Instrumental only, no vocals. No electronic beats, no synths, no four-on-the-floor kick.
